## Contract review

Nothing was built, run or re-run.

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `72b08a34cb776a955439fd51dce0227cdea30b01`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .claude/agents/os-dev.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/review-checklist.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/triage-duties.md + AGENTS.md, scripts/check-nul-bytes.mjs, scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs, scripts/pm/clause2-line.mjs, scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs, scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs, scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs, scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/filing-gate.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/director.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/skills.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/execution-duties.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/contract-review.md

**Gate verdicts read on the head (the check-runs endpoint, `per_page=100`).** First read at 2026-10-27T01:22Z: 43 runs, 24 success, 18 skipped, 1 in progress (`Lint · PM dispatch-gates`). Second read at 2026-10-27T01:24Z and third at 2026-10-27T01:30Z: 44 runs, 26 success, 18 skipped, 0 in progress, 0 failure; the run added since the first read is the `Lint & Repo Gates` aggregate, success at 2026-10-27T01:23Z. `TypeScript Type Check` success, `Lint · repo & tooling gates` (the lane that runs `check:pm-skill-ratchet` and `check:pm-skill-id-lint`, lint.yml L993 and L1003) success at 2026-10-27T01:21Z, `Governed Surface Queue Guard` success, `Check Changeset` success, `Part-of PR must not also close its card` success. Every run names head `72b08a34`.

### ① Derived judgments

**The ruling the text must say.** The maintainer tapped 「B:种类非 none 或带 (narrowing)」 on the seat thread's decision card at 2026-10-27T00:33Z: a `Metadata-protocol:` kind of `added`, `semantic` or `narrowed`, OR a `Clause-②:` line carrying the `(narrowing)` arm, owes the line. The content is the Part B draft (comment 6425690779, items 1–4, written for B).

**(a) Trigger B, one meaning — right in three files, ambiguous in the fourth.** os-dev.md L279 「种类非 `none` 或带 `(narrowing)`」, SKILL.md L313 "a kind other than `none`, or a `(narrowing)` arm", review-checklist.md L18 「种类非 `none` 或带 `(narrowing)`」 all state B exactly, no wider and no narrower. triage-duties.md L59 「改作者可写面(种类非 `none` 或收窄)的卡」 is ambiguous: in pm-dispatch's own vocabulary 收窄 names the Clause-② narrowing (contract-review.md L8 and L12 「收窄申报」, execution-duties.md L105, lanes/spec.md L20–21), but the kind `narrowed` is 收窄 in plain Chinese and already sits inside 非 `none`, so a triage reader can take the parenthesis as redundant and write no skills/docs/eval done-when for a kind-`none` + `(narrowing)` card, which is the D5 case the maintainer's B exists for. Tolerable in a first-grade done-when line because review-checklist.md L18 makes the line owed at review time regardless, so the backstop holds; but the unambiguous spelling 「或带 `(narrowing)`」 fits (106 B → 117 B, limit 120) and should ride the rework below.

**(b) The line's values and the division of labour — one ruled clause lost. FAIL.** The values (`updated here | follow-up owed — FILES | follow-up #N | none — REASON`), the dev writing it once from the diff and filing no card (os-dev.md L279, L283 untouched), the seat filing the owed card and rewriting `owed — FILES` to `#N` before ACCEPT (SKILL.md L313), and the seat's check 「在且属实;缺 ⇒ REWORK」 (review-checklist.md L18) all match the draft. The definition of `updated here` does not: the draft's item 3 reads 「`updated here` 即 diff 触 `skills/**` 或手写文档并带 eval」; the landed SKILL.md L313 reads "`updated here` = this diff teaches it in `skills/**` or the docs" — 「并带 eval」 is gone. Three findings on the head make it a lost clause and not a respelling. One, it was not forced by the budget: L313 sits inside the ```text fence opened at L302 and closed at L319, and `classifyLine` (ratchet L2698) returns the exempt `fence` class before the byte test, so the clause costs no line and no byte. Two, nothing a seat reads at review time says otherwise: `eval` occurs in pm-dispatch exactly once, triage-duties.md L59, a first-grade done-when written only for a card triage recognises before any PR exists; os-dev.md, review-checklist.md, execution-duties.md 〈复核〉 and lanes/skills.md carry no eval rule; Part A's shared acceptance (comment 6425678185) binds the eight fix cards alone, whose own PRs are kind `none` and owe no line. So a seat applying L18 「属实」 against L313's definition can ACCEPT `Skills-docs: updated here` on a diff that adds one teaching sentence and no eval — the pattern Part A measured (three of sixty protocol commits touched `skills/**`, none with an eval). Three, it is unreported: the drop is in neither `deviations` nor `rules_retired` of report 6431321367, and the PR body says the content is "items 1–4, written for B". Remedy (zero budget): on L313, `updated here` = this diff teaches it in `skills/**` or the docs and the package's evals exercise it (the draft's 「并带 eval」); if the seat means to drop the eval requirement instead, that is a change to the ruled text and goes back to the maintainer, not into a respelling.

**(c) The three retirements are payments.** (i) os-dev.md old L284 「受管路径全在 `.claude/**` 者 Tier S,达档复核 PASS 在案即由席位入队落地;余皆 Tier H 等人批。」: every clause is on the dev's mandatory reading — os-dev.md L19 makes AGENTS.md binding before the first edit, and AGENTS.md Prime Directive 14 L261–262 (Tier S by the owning seat on a contract-tier review of record), L276–283 (Tier H = every register row except `.claude/**`, an APPROVED review; Tier S = all of `.claude/**`, the seat lands it through the queue on a `## Contract review` PASS record for the current head) and Post-Task Checklist step 2 L1077–1080 (a governed diff: push, open the PR, stop; landing waits for its tier's record) say it; the seat side is SKILL.md L204 and contract-review.md L37. The dev-side consequence (never ready, arm or enqueue) is stated where the dev reads. Paid. (ii) review-checklist.md old L74: the `+0/-0` trigger and the action survive on L75 (suspect NUL first, decide on the blob, require escapes on the source side); the grep harm is os-dev.md L391 and check-nul-bytes.mjs header L35–38; the git blind spot (binary-ness decided on the first 8000 bytes) is that header's L43–45, which os-dev.md L393 names as the authority. The seat's own file keeps the operative line and loses only the why, which is one pointer away. Paid. (iii) triage-duties.md old L96: the membership rule is this file's L32–34 and the 「一律」 is L80 (人工地板 恒呈维护者) with SKILL.md L269 (需裁决先落 `needs-user-decision` 卡); the four-prong block and recommendation are SKILL.md L270, filing-gate.md L15, director.md L54 and lanes/skills.md L21; the director seat as the one presenting seat is SKILL.md L276 and filing-gate.md L27, with the pointer to `lanes/director.md` at SKILL.md L55 and triage-duties.md L5. Paid.

**(d) In-place respellings lose nothing.** SKILL.md L191: the six items sit under L188's 「其下 `## 席位核对`」 and review-checklist.md L3 names whose checklist expands them, so 「(席位读此)」 was redundant; 「范围外去向+`Skills-docs:`」 is the draft's 「范围外去向(含 `Skills-docs:` 行)」. os-dev.md L285 「声明行后」 is true on two-line and three-line PRs where 「两声明行后」 would be false on the latter; L277–278 still say the two claim lines are copied into the PR body and the changeset, which stays right (the third line is written from the diff, PR body only, as the draft says). Right.

**(e) Ratchet, byte limit, id-lint.** `git show 72b08a34:PATH | wc -l`: os-dev.md 404, SKILL.md 319, review-checklist.md 77, triage-duties.md 103, equal to CEILINGS (ratchet L1546, L407, L1199, L1307); the four blobs are identical on the merge-base `f02e6443`, on the PR's `base.sha` `61c07986` and on `origin/main` `756220c4`, so the counts hold against main too. Touched prose lines measured by `wc -c`: SKILL.md L191 115 B, os-dev.md L279 112 B and L285 105 B, review-checklist.md L18 120 B and L75 99 B, triage-duties.md L59 106 B — the report's figures; the widest non-fence, non-table line in each file is 120 B. SKILL.md L313 at 598 B is inside the fence: exempt by `classifyLine` (L2698, before the byte test), counted only under `exempt` by `scanLineLengths` (L2719), and the widest-row pin (`MAX_TABLE_ROW_BYTES`, `scanTableRows`) meters `|` rows only, so neither rule reaches it. No `#` followed by three digits in any added line; `#N` carries no digit. The gate verdict agrees: `Lint · repo & tooling gates` success, `Lint & Repo Gates` success.

**(f) No script keys on the new line.** clause2-line.mjs reads two key lines only (`CLAUSE2_KEY_LINE` L145, `METADATA_PROTOCOL_KEY_LINE` L528) and its near-miss patterns name only those keys; record-recognisers.mjs builds `keyLineRegex` for `Reviewed-by`, `Served-tier` and `Local-runs`; check-half-states.mjs reads `Seat:`, `Thread-read:`, `Clause-②` (through `readClause2Line`) and `Reviewed-by`; post-stamped.mjs refuses a claim on `Seat:`, `Thread-read:`, `Clause-②:` and `Container & model:` and a record on `Local-runs:`. None names `Skills-docs`, none counts line-initial keys, none refuses a third. `git grep Skills-docs` on `origin/main`: no hit; on the head: the four rule lines only. The template line is inside the fence of SKILL.md 〈模板与表〉, a file and not a claim comment, so no claim checker sees it, and a claim copies `Metadata-protocol: none` without the parenthetical. The other readers of the kind line (check-changeset-no-major.mjs, check-adr-0087-registration.mjs, pr-automation.yml) import the same reader.

**(g) The PR body dogfoods the current shape.** Line 1 `Part of #26184` — right: the card carries `pm:dispatched`, an assignee and eight live Part A children, and comment 6425927987 says it stays open for this landing; the seat closes it by hand after landing (review-checklist.md L12–13) or says it stays open as the anchor. Lines 2–3 are line-initial `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none`. 维护者速读 carries the six fixed lines with 需要你做的 = 「无,席位落地」 (Tier S). What changes / Tests / Acceptance notes / Verification are present, the log readings folded. The body's own claim that it owes no `Skills-docs:` line is correct under B: kind `none`, no arm. The 两分钟验证 readings reproduce on the head: `git grep -c 'Skills-docs:' -- .claude` gives os-dev.md 1, SKILL.md 2, review-checklist.md 1, nothing else.

**(h) Claim surface and report shape.** Claim 6430787650 names exactly the four files; the PR's file list is those four, +7/−7 in one commit. Report 6431321367 carries `files_changed` (4), `deviations` (10), `line_budget` (4 files) and `rules_retired` (5). Branch `claude/project-thread-1r3slx` is the claim's branch, the measured platform exception. Base: the PR's `base.sha` `61c07986` is main's tip when the PR opened at 2026-10-27T01:16Z; the merge-base of `origin/main` and the head is `f02e6443`, the report's rebase point; `f02e6443` is an ancestor of `61c07986`, which is on `origin/main`, and the four files did not change between them, so the REST diff and `git diff f02e6443 72b08a34` are the same +7/−7 (the scratch copy and the REST diff compare identical). The commit carries the model-free trailer pair os-dev.md L283 asks for.

### ② Semver level

Right. The diff is `.claude/**` only, which publishes nothing; the PR carries `skip-changeset` and no `.changeset/*.md` (execution-duties.md L179 does not bind); `Check Changeset` is success on the head. Both declaration lines are line-initial on the PR body: `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`.

### ③ Boundary flags

- The dev's out-of-scope finding — the ratchet's tighten hint for `.claude/skills/spec-property-retirement/SKILL.md`'s table-row pin (326 → 324, headroom 2) — is a shrink-only pin hygiene reminder: filing-gate.md L18 and L20 keep it out of a card; it goes in the skills lane's 收班简报 and rides the next PR that touches that file. carrier: none.
- triage-duties.md L59 「或收窄」: respell as 「或带 `(narrowing)`」 in the rework (fits at 117 B); see (a).
- AGENTS.md Prime Directive 14 L266 says the listed surfaces are "all Tier H" while L277 and L280 of the same directive say `.claude/**` is Tier S — a pre-existing contradiction on `origin/main`, outside this diff; AGENTS.md is Tier H at 1112/1112, so a one-line 收班简报 note for the maintainer, not this PR.
- Landing to-do for the seat once this lands: `Part of` leaves #26184 open; close it by hand with the `pm:dispatched` removal, or record that it stays open as the Part A anchor.

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-1r3slx` (the seat's in-session os-dev subagent, mode:subagent)
Reviewed-by: `session_01LqKsGyMNFwwnbF5FTAqyPn` (independent contract-review subagent)

**VERDICT: FAIL** — item (b): the ruled definition of `updated here` lost its eval clause on SKILL.md L313 (budget-free to restore; unreported as a deviation), so a seat could ACCEPT an eval-less `updated here` with no rule saying otherwise. Everything else holds; fix (b) and the (a) spelling on the same head and re-review is a re-read of two lines.

**What moved between the heads.** `9dd75f01` is one commit whose parent is `72b08a34` (no force-push; the branch history before it is untouched). `git diff 72b08a34 9dd75f01` touches two paths and nothing else in the tree: SKILL.md L313 (one hunk) and triage-duties.md L59 (one hunk), +2/−2. Blob ids: os-dev.md `42d30a3f` on both heads (identical), review-checklist.md `38dfb316` on both heads (identical), SKILL.md `4f98f599` → `079cadcb` and triage-duties.md `c0361838` → `4af797a4`, each differing in exactly the one line named. So items (c), (d), (f) and (h) of record 6431523599 carry over by reference: every cited home of the three retirements, the two in-place respellings, the parser readings and the claim surface sit on lines these two hunks do not touch.

**Gate verdicts read on the head (the check-runs endpoint, `per_page=100`).** Three reads at 2026-10-27T01:48Z, 2026-10-27T01:49Z and 2026-10-27T01:50Z, all identical: 45 runs, 28 success, 17 skipped, 0 in progress, 0 failure, every run naming head `9dd75f01`. `Lint & Repo Gates` aggregate success at 2026-10-27T01:44Z; `Lint · repo & tooling gates` (the lane that runs `check:pm-skill-ratchet` and `check:pm-skill-id-lint`) success at 2026-10-27T01:43Z; `Lint · PM dispatch-gates` success; `TypeScript Type Check` success; `Governed Surface Queue Guard` success; `Test Core` and `Dogfood Regression Gate` success; `Part-of PR must not also close its card`, `No other open PR may claim the same single-writer path` and `The card this PR closes must claim this branch` success on both the push event and the body-edit event. `Check Changeset` reads skipped on both of this head's runs: that is the listed expected skip in check-expected-skips.mjs (`gate: label skip-changeset` — every run after the label lands reads skipped; the first head's `opened` run concluded success before the label was visible). `Check PR Size` success on the push event and skipped on the `edited` event (the listed event-gate skip). The remaining skips (`Build Core`, `Build Docs`, `Build UI Deps`, `Lint UI`, `Type Check UI`, `Temporal Conformance`, the matrix shards, the two opt-in harnesses) are the same path- and label-gated set the first head showed.

### ① Derived judgments

**(a) Trigger B, one meaning, now in one spelling.** triage-duties.md L59 reads 「改作者可写面(种类非 `none` 或带 `(narrowing)`)的卡,首触 done-when 写 skills + docs + eval 三项。」 — the same arm spelling as os-dev.md L279, SKILL.md L313 and review-checklist.md L18; a kind-`none` card whose Clause-② narrows is unmistakably inside the first-grade done-when. Measured by `wc -c` without the newline: 117 B (limit 120). Right.

**(b) The ruled definition of `updated here` is restored.** SKILL.md L313 now reads "`updated here` = this diff teaches it in `skills/**` or the docs and the package's evals exercise it" — the draft's 「并带 eval」 (comment 6425690779, item 3) in meaning, placed on the template line that review-checklist.md L18 「属实」 is judged against, so a seat can no longer ACCEPT an eval-less `updated here` under the rule as written. The rest of the parenthetical (the trigger, the four values, the dev writing it from the diff, the seat filing the owed card and rewriting `owed — FILES` to `#N` before ACCEPT) is byte-identical to the first head. The line is 634 B inside the ```text fence opened at L302 and closed at L319; `classifyLine` returns the exempt `fence` class before the byte test and the widest-row pin meters `|` rows only, so no ratchet rule reaches it. Report 6431681340 names the restoration under `deviations` and `rework_of`, and `rules_retired` is empty — nothing was paid for, nothing was lost. Right; the FAIL item is closed.

**(c) The three retirements** — unchanged lines on both sides (os-dev.md and review-checklist.md identical blobs; triage-duties.md differs only at L59, so L5, L32–34 and L80 stand as cited); paid, by reference to record 6431523599.

**(d) In-place respellings** — SKILL.md L191 and os-dev.md L285 are untouched by the rework; right, by reference.

**(e) Ratchet, byte limit, id-lint, re-read on this head.** `git show 9dd75f01:PATH | wc -l`: os-dev.md 404, SKILL.md 319, review-checklist.md 77, triage-duties.md 103, equal to CEILINGS. The widest non-fence, non-table line in each of the four files is 120 B; the only line the rework widened past the limit is the fenced L313 (exempt as above). No `#` followed by three digits in the two added lines; `#N` carries no digit. `git grep -c 'Skills-docs:' -- .claude` on the head: os-dev.md 1, SKILL.md 2, review-checklist.md 1, nothing else — the body's 两分钟验证 readings hold. The gate verdict agrees: `Lint · repo & tooling gates` success, `Lint & Repo Gates` success.

**(f) No script keys on the new line** — the rework adds no key and no token a parser names (the two readers of the kind line and the record readers are unchanged on this head); right, by reference.

**(g) The PR body matches the head.** The seat patched it at 2026-10-27T01:47Z. Lines 1–3 unchanged and line-initial: `Part of #26184`, `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`. What changes item 1 names the restored clause and reads 251 → 634 B; item 4 quotes the new L59 and reads 117 B; the byte table carries 634 B and 117 B; Verification is headed `Head 9dd75f01` with the rework named against record 6431523599; Tests says the union was re-run on `9dd75f01`; no stale figure survives (no 598, no 106, no 「或收窄」). ## 维护者速读
改了什么:pm-dispatch 规则文本多一条 PR 正文声明行 `Skills-docs:`——元数据协议种类非 `none`,或 `Clause-②:` 带 `(narrowing)` 的 PR,dev 按 diff 写明技能与文档是「已随本 PR 更新(且该包 eval 覆盖)/ 欠后续(列文件)/ 已有后续卡 / 不欠(写原因)」;席位核对该行、代立后续卡并改写成卡号;分诊给会改作者可写面的卡写 skills + docs + eval 三项 done-when。四个 `.claude/**` 文件各净 0 行;无门禁、无脚本读它。
为什么改:你在席位线程的决策卡上选了「B:种类非 none 或带 (narrowing)」(director 席在 #26369 记的同一字母);此前协议变了没有一行要求技能与文档跟上,字段权限 `when` 落地后技能一字未提就是本卡起因。
